purpose: separate fleet breadth, repository penetration depth, structural decomposition, workflow representation and runtime proof

metric.runtime: reported separately as R0-R7 and MUST NOT be inferred from Pen
anti_gaming: high breadth with shallow depth yields low Pen
deep inspection of a tiny unrepresentative surface yields low Pen
runtime is independent: Pen=1.0 with R0 still means no executed proof

GEOGRAPHER.mission: map the estate and horizontal surface area

GEOLOGIST.mission: penetrate repository strata and resolve what lies beneath root-level visibility

NEURON.mission: decompose systems and repositories into nodes, edges, atoms, graphs, dependencies, interfaces and dependency pressure

CALLIGRAPHER.mission: translate observed structures and execution sequences into human-readable operational flows
CALLIGRAPHER.rule: Calligrapher represents evidence and governed models; it does not invent missing nodes, edges, states or execution steps

CARTOGRAPHER_OCULARS.mission: render multi-view fleet topology, temporal evolution and dashboards
CARTOGRAPHER_OCULARS.distinction: Cartographer/Oculars presents the map; Calligrapher encodes process/workflow flow; Geographer measures breadth; Geologist measures depth; Neuron decomposes structure.

RUNNER.mission: convert mapped, penetrated and decomposed paths into observed >0-step evidence

canonical_handoff: SCOUT -> GEOGRAPHER -> GEOLOGIST -> NEURON -> CALLIGRAPHER -> RUNNER -> QA/SIGNALMAN -> MISSIONCONTROL -> CARTOGRAPHER/OCULARS

breadth.B5: has accepted cross-feed consumer or explicit NO_CROSS_FEED_JUSTIFIED

penetration.P2: root files + hidden control dirs such as .github/.devcontainer/.vscode + primary manifests
penetration.P4: recursive tree census including nested hidden dirs, generated/config surfaces, nested manifests and candidate subprojects
penetration.P5: subrepo/submodule/workspace/monorepo boundaries resolved; nested packages or embedded repos classified individually
penetration.P6: execution path traced from entrypoint through dependencies/workflows to outputs/receipts
penetration.P7: multiple meaningful execution paths + failure/edge paths exercised; cross-module behavior observed
penetration.P8: CONTROL depth: repeated exact-SHA runtime plus drift/recensus and accepted federation returns

runtime.R2: static validation/lint/config parse or cheap non-domain probe
runtime.R3: one bounded >0-step execution at exact source identity
runtime.R4: deterministic repeat or same-path repeat at distinct evidence point
runtime.R7: recurring CONTROL runtime with telemetry and drift detection

nested_surface_rules: dot-prefixed directories are first-class surfaces, not ignored noise
detect .gitmodules, nested .git boundaries where observable, package manifests, workspace files, Dockerfiles, devcontainers, workflows, scripts, tests, docs, examples and generated folders
a nested package or embedded project receives its own B/P/R state when it has an independent manifest, workflow, build, runtime or authority boundary
large upstream repositories may be breadth-covered while intentionally shallow-penetrated until value justifies deeper traversal
P4+ requires recursive structure evidence rather than README inference
P6+ requires traced execution evidence; source reading alone cannot satisfy runtime depth
